column11: Description
Primary Key. Auto-generated identity value.
Unique name for the hall type. E.g: "Loại A"
Minimum price per table for this hall type. Must be >= 10000 VNĐ.

column4:
- HallTypeName must be unique across all hall types.
- If duplicate name entered, system shows error message: "Tên loại sảnh đã tồn tại!"

- MinTablePrice must be greater than or equal to 10,000 VNĐ.
- If invalid price, system shows error message: "Đơn giá bàn tối thiểu phải >= 10,000 VNĐ!"

- Cannot delete HallType if there are Halls referencing it.
- System shows: "Không thể xóa loại sảnh đang được sử dụng!"
- If any mandatory field is left blank, system shows error message: "Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ thông tin!"

column11: Description
Primary Key. Auto-generated identity value.
Foreign Key to HallType. Dropdown selection.
Unique name for the hall. E.g: "Sảnh A1"
Maximum number of tables the hall can accommodate. Must be > 0.
Optional notes about the hall.

column4:
- HallName must be unique across all halls.
- If duplicate name entered, system shows error message: "Tên sảnh đã tồn tại!"

- MaxTableCount must be greater than 0.
- If invalid, system shows error message: "Số bàn tối đa phải lớn hơn 0!"

- Cannot delete Hall if there are Bookings referencing it.
- System shows: "Không thể xóa sảnh đang có tiệc cưới đặt!"
- When HallType is selected, MinTablePrice is auto-filled from HallType.MinTablePrice.
- If any mandatory field is left blank, system shows error message: "Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ thông tin!"

column11: Description
Primary Key. Auto-generated identity value.
Unique name for the shift. E.g: "Trưa"
Start time of the shift. Format: HH:mm.
End time of the shift. Format: HH:mm. Must be > StartTime.

column4:
- ShiftName must be unique across all shifts.
- If duplicate name entered, system shows error message: "Tên ca đã tồn tại!"

- StartTime must be between 07:30 and 24:00.
- EndTime must be greater than StartTime.
- If invalid, system shows error message: "Thời gian ca không hợp lệ!"

- Cannot delete Shift if there are Bookings referencing it.
- System shows: "Không thể xóa ca đang có tiệc cưới đặt!"
- If any mandatory field is left blank, system shows error message: "Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ thông tin!"

column11: Description
Primary Key. Auto-generated identity value.
Unique name for the dish. E.g: "Gà hấp"
Price per dish. Must be > 0.
Optional notes about the dish.

column4:
- DishName must be unique across all dishes.
- If duplicate name entered, system shows error message: "Tên món ăn đã tồn tại!"

- UnitPrice must be greater than 0.
- If invalid, system shows error message: "Đơn giá phải lớn hơn 0!"

- System allows maximum 100 dishes.
- If exceeded, system shows: "Số lượng món ăn đã đạt giới hạn tối đa (100)!"

- Cannot delete Dish if it's used in any Menu.
- System shows: "Không thể xóa món ăn đang được sử dụng trong thực đơn!"
- If any mandatory field is left blank, system shows error message: "Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ thông tin!"

column11: Description
Primary Key. Auto-generated identity value.
Unique name for the service. E.g: "Trang trí hoa"
Price per service unit. Can be 0 (free services).
Optional notes about the service.

column4:
- ServiceName must be unique across all services.
- If duplicate name entered, system shows error message: "Tên dịch vụ đã tồn tại!"

- UnitPrice must be >= 0.
- If negative, system shows error message: "Đơn giá không được âm!"

- Cannot delete Service if it's used in any ServiceDetail.
- System shows: "Không thể xóa dịch vụ đang được sử dụng!"
- If any mandatory field is left blank, system shows error message: "Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ thông tin!"

column11: Description
Primary Key. Auto-generated identity value.
Full name of the groom.
Full name of the bride.
Contact phone number. 10 digits.
Date when booking was created. Auto-set to today.
Date of the wedding event. Must be >= Today + 3 days.
Foreign Key to Shift. Dropdown selection.
Foreign Key to Hall. Filtered by availability.
Number of tables booked. Must meet MinReserveTableRate.
Number of reserve tables. <= MaxTableCount - TableCount.
Deposit paid. Must >= MinDepositRate × Estimated Total.
Price per table at booking time. From Hall → HallType.MinTablePrice.
Calculated: TableCount × (TablePrice + Menu Total per table).
Calculated: Sum of all ServiceDetail amounts.
Calculated: TotalTableAmount + TotalServiceAmount + AdditionalCost + PenaltyAmount.
Calculated: TotalInvoiceAmount - Deposit.
Additional/damage fees added at payment time.
Late payment penalty. Calculated if payment > WeddingDate.
Date when final payment was made. NULL if unpaid.

column2: Related Screens: BookingListScreen.xaml; AddBookingScreen.xaml; BookingDetailScreen.xaml; InvoiceScreen.xaml

column4:
- WeddingDate must be at least 3 days from today.
- If invalid, system shows: "Ngày cưới phải cách ngày đặt ít nhất 3 ngày!"

- One hall can only have one booking per shift per day.
- If conflict, system shows: "Sảnh đã được đặt vào ngày và ca này!"

- TableCount >= MinReserveTableRate × Hall.MaxTableCount (default 85%).
- If invalid, system shows: "Số lượng bàn phải >= [MinRatio]% sức chứa sảnh!"

- ReserveTableCount <= Hall.MaxTableCount - TableCount.
- If exceeded, system shows: "Số bàn dự trữ vượt quá số bàn còn lại của sảnh!"

- Deposit >= MinDepositRate × Estimated Total (default 15%).
- If insufficient, system shows: "Tiền cọc phải >= [MinRate]% tổng tiền ước tính!"

- At least one dish must be selected in the menu.
- If empty, system shows: "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một món ăn!"

- If PaymentDate > WeddingDate and EnablePenalty = 1:
  PenaltyAmount = (PaymentDate - WeddingDate) × PenaltyRate × TotalInvoiceAmount
- If any mandatory field is left blank, system shows error message: "Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ thông tin!"

column11: Description
Foreign Key to Booking. Part of composite PK.
Foreign Key to Dish. Part of composite PK.
Quantity per table. Must be > 0.
Price at booking time. Copied from Dish.UnitPrice.
Optional notes for this menu item.

column4:
- Combination of (BookingId, DishId) must be unique.
- Cannot add same dish twice to one booking.

- Quantity must be greater than 0.
- If invalid, system shows: "Số lượng phải lớn hơn 0!"

- UnitPrice is captured at booking time to preserve historical pricing.
- Changes to Dish.UnitPrice do not affect existing bookings.

- Each booking must have at least one menu item.
- If empty, system shows: "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một món ăn!"

column11: Description

column3: Transaction Detail - ServiceDetail (Chi tiết Dịch vụ)

column11: Foreign Key to Booking. Part of composite PK.
Foreign Key to Service. Part of composite PK.
Number of service units. Must be > 0.
Price at booking time. Copied from Service.UnitPrice.
Calculated: Quantity × UnitPrice.
Optional notes for this service.

column4:
- Combination of (BookingId, ServiceId) must be unique.
- Cannot add same service twice to one booking.

- Quantity must be greater than 0.
- If invalid, system shows: "Số lượng phải lớn hơn 0!"

- UnitPrice is captured at booking time to preserve historical pricing.
- Changes to Service.UnitPrice do not affect existing bookings.

- TotalAmount is automatically calculated: Quantity × UnitPrice.
- Updates Booking.TotalServiceAmount via trigger.

column11: Description

column3: Report - RevenueReport (Báo cáo Doanh số Tháng)

column11: Month of report (1-12). Part of composite PK.
Year of report. Part of composite PK.
Total revenue for the month. Sum of all daily revenues.

column4:
- Combination of (Month, Year) must be unique.
- One report per month per year.

- Report is automatically generated/updated when viewing.
- Aggregates data from Booking table where PaymentDate is in the month/year.
- TotalRevenue = Sum of Booking.TotalInvoiceAmount where PaymentDate falls in the month/year.

column11: Description

column3: Report Detail - RevenueReportDetail (Chi tiết Báo cáo Doanh số)

column11: Day of month (1-31). Part of composite PK.
Month of report. Part of composite FK to RevenueReport.
Year of report. Part of composite FK to RevenueReport.
Number of weddings with payment on this day.
Total revenue for this day.
Percentage of daily revenue vs monthly total.

column4:
- Combination of (Day, Month, Year) must be unique.
- One detail record per day.

- WeddingCount = COUNT of Booking where PaymentDate = this day.
- Revenue = SUM of Booking.TotalInvoiceAmount where PaymentDate = this day.
- Ratio = (Revenue / RevenueReport.TotalRevenue) × 100.

column11: Description

column3: System - Parameter (Quy định / Tham số Hệ thống)

column11: Primary Key. Name of the parameter.
Value of the parameter. Interpretation depends on ParameterName.

column4: Late payment penalty rate per day (1% = 0.01).
Minimum table ratio vs hall capacity (85% = 0.85).

- Only Administrator can modify parameters.
- Staff cannot access parameter settings.

- Rate values (PenaltyRate, MinDepositRate, MinReserveTableRate) must be between 0 and 1.
- If invalid, system shows: "Giá trị tỷ lệ phải từ 0 đến 1!"

- EnablePenalty must be 0 or 1.
- If invalid, system shows: "Giá trị bật/tắt phải là 0 hoặc 1!"

column11: Description
Primary Key. Short code for permission. E.g: "P001".
Display name of the permission. E.g: "Quản lý Sảnh".
Name of the XAML screen to load. E.g: "HallManagementScreen".

column4:
- Permission records are system-managed.
- Users cannot directly add/edit/delete permissions.
- LoadedScreenName must match an existing XAML UserControl name in Presentation folder.

column11: Description
Primary Key. Short code for user group. E.g: "G001".
Display name of the user group. E.g: "Quản lý"; "Nhân viên".

column4:
- GroupName must be unique across all user groups.
- If duplicate, system shows: "Tên nhóm người dùng đã tồn tại!"

- Cannot use 'Administrator' or 'admin' as group name (reserved for system).
- System shows: "Không thể sử dụng tên nhóm này!"

- Cannot delete UserGroup if there are AppUsers assigned to it.
- System shows: "Không thể xóa nhóm đang có người dùng!"

- Group permissions are managed via GroupPermission junction table.
- Admin can assign/remove permissions for each group.

column11: Description
Foreign Key to UserGroup. Part of composite PK.
Foreign Key to Permission. Part of composite PK.

column4:
- Combination of (GroupId, PermissionId) must be unique.
- Same permission cannot be assigned twice to same group.

- Admin can toggle permission assignment by checking/unchecking.
- Insert record when checked, delete when unchecked.

- Only Administrator can modify group permissions.
- Staff cannot access permission management.

column11: Description
Primary Key. Auto-generated identity value.
Login username. Must be unique. Cannot change after creation.
MD5 hashed password. Never displayed.
Full name of the user.
Email address. Must be unique if provided.
Contact phone number.
Home address.
Date of birth.
Gender: "Nam" / "Nữ" / "Khác".
Foreign Key to UserGroup. Determines permissions.

column4:
- Username must be unique across all users.
- If duplicate, system shows: "Tên đăng nhập đã tồn tại!"

- If Email is provided, it must be unique.
- If duplicate, system shows: "Email đã được sử dụng!"

- Password is hashed using MD5 before storage.
- Original password is never stored or displayed.

- Username cannot be changed after user creation.
- Field is read-only in edit mode.

- Users can edit their own profile via Account screen.
- Users cannot change their own UserGroup.

- Only Administrator can add/edit/delete users.
- Administrator can assign UserGroup to users.

- Cannot delete the last Administrator user.
- System shows: "Không thể xóa người quản trị cuối cùng!"
- If any mandatory field is left blank, system shows error message: "Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ thông tin!"
